s: Closure dates listed against a Holiday scheme will automatically be recorded as absences against all employee appointments linked to the scheme. Holiday schemes are linked to employee appointments via the Balance assignment. Multiple Balances may be linked to the same holiday scheme.
ss: Holiday schemes in WFM (CoreTime/CoreRoster) automatically record closure dates as absences for all employees linked to the scheme, and must be updated each year when departments communicate their closure days. This guide covers how to add new closure dates to a holiday scheme, adjust floating day allocations in associated balances to maintain the 38-day university entitlement, and extend balance periods and calendars for future leave years. Open this document when you need to configure annual closure dates, ensure balance entitlements are accurate after closure day changes, or set up leave year periods for upcoming years. Note that as of March 2022, this process has no equivalent in the portal system and no planned migration date.
sl: This document is a how-to guide for HR Systems personnel detailing the procedures for updating holiday schemes in the WFM (Workforce Management) system version 1.1, specifically explaining how to record closure dates that will automatically populate as absences across all employee appointments linked to a holiday scheme. The document covers five main processes: introducing holiday schemes and their connection to employee balances, updating holiday schemes through the CoreTime/CoreRoster menu path (System Parameters > Holiday Schemes > Company Holiday Details), amending floating day allocations in associated balances to ensure total entitlements equal 38 days, extending balance periods when new leave years require configuration, and extending the balance calendar to support future leave year periods. Users navigate to specific screens such as Balances > Entitlements Per Balance and Balances > Calendars to enter or modify details including Holiday Date fields, Pay Codes (such as Code 160 for Public Holidays and Code 3701 for Fixed Closure Days), Days and Hours columns, and Period fields using the list of values (LOV). The document addresses the scenario where multiple balance versions exist for different employee groups (G1-5 support staff and G6+ academic-related staff) with different FTE hours (37.5 or 36.5), both requiring updates to reflect closure day changes, and includes specific formulas and calculations such as converting days to hours using 7.5 hours per day for 37.5 FTE balances and 7.3 for 36.5 FTE balances. As of March 2022, TAG has confirmed there is no portal equivalent for this process and no planned migration date, meaning this WFM system procedure remains the current standard for this task.

ss: Payroll Officers use this process to transfer casual worker hours from CoreTime to CorePay once the payroll deadline has passed and departments have resolved unapproved timesheets. The transfer involves two stages: first running a test mode to review errors and warnings by work group, then switching to final mode to create the timesheets and progress CoreTime to the next month. Open this guide when you're ready to process monthly casual payroll and need step-by-step instructions for navigating the Generate Timesheets function, understanding error codes, and confirming control totals before the final transfer.
sl: This document provides a detailed step-by-step guide for Payroll Officers managing casual payroll at the University of Oxford to transfer hours from CoreTime to CorePay and advance the payroll period. The process involves two main parts: first, a test mode review in CoreTime > Period End > Generate Timesheets where users configure the Company field to "University of Oxford," Calendar Code to "A" (New Monthly), and select specific work groups or all work groups using the Work Group From and Work Group To fields to identify errors and warnings before final processing. The second part requires switching the Mode field from Test to Final, which automatically selects all work groups, and after reviewing the Controls Totals window (showing total hours, breakdown by pay code, and worker headcount), clicking Create Timesheets to transfer the data to CorePay and progress the CoreTime period to the next month. t: Allowances
s:
# Summary: PeopleXD HR System "Allowances" Guide

This guide teaches users how to manage employee allowances within the People Management module of the PeopleXD HR system.

## What You'll Learn:

**Core Concepts:**
- The distinction between allowances managed in HR (permanent, recurring payments assigned to employee contracts) versus one-off payments handled in Payroll
- Different allowance types supported by the system
- How allowances interact with pay multipliers and annual allowance indicators

**Practical Skills:**
Users will learn how to perform the following allowance management tasks:
- **View allowances** — locate and access allowance records, understand different allowance statuses
- **Create allowances** — add new allowances to employee contracts, including how different allowance types have different setup screens, and how to create annualised allowances
- **Edit allowances** — modify existing allowance records
- **End allowances** — terminate allowances with end dates, and remove end dates if needed
- **Cancel and delete allowances** — remove allowance records from the system
- **Understand salary impacts** — recognize how changes to salary multipliers affect existing allowances

## Key Concept:

The guide emphasizes that People Management handles **permanent or recurring allowances** (like a regular night duty allowance of £25 per month that recalculates each payroll period), whereas one-off payments are processed separately in Payroll.
ss: Allowances in People Management covers how to set up and manage recurring employee allowances—such as night duty payments, shift allowances, and scaled allowances—that are automatically calculated and included in payroll each period. This guide walks you through creating, editing, ending, and cancelling allowance records on employee contracts, and explains how different allowance types (value-based, percentage-based, scaled, and negative) work in the system. Open this document when you need to assign a new allowance to an employee's contract, make changes to an existing allowance, or understand how allowances interact with salary updates and payroll processing.
sl: This user guide provides comprehensive guidance on managing employee allowance records within the People Management system, specifically covering how permanent or recurring allowances are created, edited, and maintained on employee contracts. The document explains key concepts including the distinction between allowances managed in People Management versus one-off payments handled directly in Payroll, and details four main allowance types: Value allowances (either Standard Value with fixed amounts or Variable Value with employee-specific amounts), Percentage allowances (calculated as a percentage of gross salary), Scaled allowances (operating on a point-on-scale basis with date-effective tracking), and Negative allowances (which deduct amounts from salary). The guide outlines specific operational tasks such as viewing allowance statuses, adding new allowances through dedicated screens that vary by allowance type, editing existing allowances, ending allowances with optional removal of end dates, and cancelling or deleting allowances entirely. It also addresses important configuration settings including the Pay Group 'Annual Allowance Indicator' and the Pay Multiplier, explaining how changes to salary multipliers impact existing allowances. This resource is designed for HR and People Management users who need to configure and maintain employee allowance records on the CoreHR system within the Access Group's People Management module.

t: Assign Access
s:
# Summary of "Assign Access" Guide

This guide teaches HR administrators how to manage employee system access and security permissions directly from an employee's record in the PeopleXD HR system.

After reading this guide, users will understand how to:

1. **Navigate to the Assign Access screen** — by accessing the Command Centre widget, searching for an employee, opening their record, and selecting the Assign Access option from the Actions menu.

2. **Control different types of user access**, including:
   - **Menu Profiles** — restricting what system features, dashboards, screens, buttons, and widgets an employee can access
   - **Pay User Access** — granting access to payroll data based on Pay Group assignment, so payroll administrators can only view and process payrolls for their assigned groups
   - **Organisational Roles** — assigning managerial and approval responsibilities such as HR Salary Approver, Payroll Salary Approver, or Manager Dashboard access
   - **Recruitment Access** — controlling which departments' vacancy and applicant records an employee can view
   - **HR User Access, Expense, Training, Document, Team Area, Time Privileges, and Roster Privileges** — managing access to these additional system modules

The guide provides a structured overview of all available security categories that can be configured for each employee through a single Assign Access screen.
ss: The Assign Access screen in PeopleXD People Management allows HR administrators to manage employee security roles and system access directly from an employee's record. You can assign multiple types of access permissions including menu profiles, pay groups, organizational roles, recruitment and HR user access, expense groups, training, documents, WFM team areas, and time and roster privileges. Open this guide when you need to grant or modify an employee's system permissions across dashboards, payroll, recruitment, training, and workforce management functions. The process involves navigating to an employee record, selecting Assign Access, and using the left-hand menu to assign the appropriate access categories and privileges.
sl: This guide provides an overview of the Assign Access screen within PeopleXD People Management, which enables HR administrators to manage employee security roles and privileges directly from an employee's record. The document describes how to access the Assign Access screen by navigating through the Command Centre widget, searching for an employee, opening their record, and selecting Actions followed by Assign Access. The guide details twelve distinct security categories available on the left-hand menu, each controlling different system access levels: Menu Profiles restrict access to dashboards, screens, buttons, and widgets; Pay Users controls access to payroll data grouped at pay group level; Org Roles assigns managerial or approval responsibilities such as HR Salary Approver or Reports to; Recruitment controls access to vacancy and applicant records at department level; HR User Access grants access to employee, post, and contract data based on organisational structure; Expense controls access grouped at expense group level; Training restricts department-level data access; Document controls file access by document type; Team Area manages WFM roster visibility at team area level; Time Privileges and Roster Privileges assign approval responsibilities for specific workforce management tasks. The guide explains that changes can be applied at a future date using the Change Effective Date feature, and provides step-by-step procedures for assigning menu profiles, pay groups, and organisational roles, with all changes automatically saved upon assignment. This user guide is designed for HR administrators managing employee access and security configurations within the PeopleXD system.

sl: This user guide document describes the Assign Access screen within PeopleXD People Management, which allows HR administrators to manage employee security roles and access privileges directly from individual employee records. t: Contract Amendments
s:
# Contract Amendments Guide Summary

This guide teaches HR administrators how to manage and modify employee contracts in the PeopleXD People Management system.

**Main topics covered:**

**Contract Amendments** — The guide explains when and how to amend existing employee contracts, distinguishing between two types:
- **Amendments with no salary impact** (such as changes to work group, cost centre, location, or hierarchy fields) — these can be updated directly on the contract without affecting payroll
- **Amendments with salary impact** (such as changes to hours or pay-related terms) — these require corresponding updates to the employee's salary record

**Change of Hours** — Specific guidance on how to process and record changes to an employee's contracted hours.

**Contract Timeline and History** — How to access and review the complete timeline of all amendments made to an employee's contract, including historical sequences.

**Contract Deletion** — Instructions for deleting contracts, including how to handle replacement contracts (contracts that replace existing ones) and additional contracts (supplementary contracts for the same employee).

**Amendment Deletion** — How to remove or undo a previously recorded amendment.

**Switching Posts** — Procedures for moving an employee to a different post, including relevant task lists and terms and conditions to be aware of.

The guide provides step-by-step instructions for navigating the People Management system to perform these contract management tasks.
ss: Contract amendments in People Management allow HR administrators to update employee contracts for changes like shifts in hours, work location, job title, or organizational assignments. Open this guide when you need to modify an existing employee contract—whether the change affects salary (such as reduced hours requiring pro-rated pay) or has no salary impact (such as a change in work group or cost centre). The document covers the step-by-step process for making amendments, tracking contract history and timelines, deleting contracts, and switching posts. Use it to understand when amendments are necessary, how to execute them through the 2-step Edit Contract wizard, and which fields can be updated without triggering downstream payroll changes.
sl: This user guide provides comprehensive instructions for amending employee contracts within the People Management system, covering both technical steps and business scenarios that HR administrators encounter. The document describes the complete contract amendment workflow, including navigating to the Command Centre widget, searching for employees, and accessing the Contracts tab where users click Update in the Amendments section to initiate a 2-step Edit Contract wizard with Org Structure and Contract configuration steps. It addresses two distinct amendment types: amendments with no salary impact (such as changes to cost centre, location, workgroup, job title, or employee status) where specific fields like Contracted Hours, FTE, and Contracted Weeks must not be modified, and amendments with salary impact (such as reduced hours requiring pro-rated salary adjustments) where the reason code selected drives an automated salary amendment process. Key fields available for amendment include Effective Date (mandatory for all amendments and displayed on the Contract Timeline/History), Reason (mandatory to track amendment justification), Target End Date, Planned End Date, Job Category, Post Type, and various status and FTE-related fields. The guide also covers related contract management tasks including deleting contracts, creating replacement or additional contracts, deleting amendments, switching posts, and tracking contract timelines and historical sequences. This resource is designed for HR administrators and personnel managers who need to maintain accurate employee contract records in response to organizational changes, staffing adjustments, or employment condition modifications.

t: Contract End Date Amendments
s:
# Summary: Contract End Date Amendments Guide

This guide teaches users how to modify or remove end dates that have been assigned to an employee's contract in the PeopleXD HR system, using the People Management module.

**What you'll learn to do:**

- **Change an employee's contract end date** — particularly for employees marked as leavers, by accessing their employee record, navigating to the Contracts tab, and using the "Amend End Date" function. The process involves selecting the correct contract (identifying ones with "Dormant" status and an existing end date), entering a new date in DD-Mon-YYYY format, and confirming the change.

- **Remove an end date** from a leaver's contract entirely.

- **Understand the impact of changes** — when you update a leaving date, the system shows you an overview screen that indicates which related data will be automatically updated and which items require manual review by you.

- **Handle automatic updates to related records** — specifically, the system automatically adjusts team area end dates to match the new contract end date (when they previously matched the old leaving date), removing the need for separate manual updates in most cases.

- **Identify mismatched dates** — the guide explains how the system flags situations where end dates don't align across different records, flagging these for your review since they won't be automatically corrected.

- **Manage user access expiry** — the guide covers how end dates interact with user access permissions in the system.
ss: Amending contract end dates in CoreHR People Management covers how to change or remove leaving dates that have been applied to an employee's contract, particularly for leavers. Use this guide when you need to update a leaver's end date to a new date, remove an end date that was applied in error, or understand how changes automatically cascade to team areas and user access records. The process involves accessing the employee record, navigating to the Contracts tab, and selecting either "Amend End Date" or "Delete End Date" depending on your needs.
sl: This user guide provides comprehensive instructions for managing contract end dates in the CoreHR People Management system, specifically addressing how to change or amend end dates that have been applied to employee contracts and how to remove them entirely. The document details two primary processes: changing an end date for a leaver and removing an end date, both accessed through the Command Centre > Employee screen by navigating to the Contracts tab and selecting the Amend End Date option in the Summary section. When amending an end date, users must enter the new date in DD-Mon-YYYY format and are presented with an Amend Contract End Date overview screen that displays status indicators (To be reviewed or No change required) showing which system areas are automatically updated versus those requiring manual intervention. The guide explains critical automatic system behaviors, including how the platform automatically synchronizes team area end dates with contract end dates when they match, and how it handles User Access (JML) end dates differently depending on whether the leave date is being amended in the future, removed from the future, or amended/removed from the past. Removing an end date—typically used to correct records where an end date was applied in error—restores the employee's record to Active status across both employee and contract records, though this process is only available if the employee has not yet been processed by Payroll. The document is intended for People Management administrators and HR personnel who need to manage employee contract lifecycle events and correct leaver-related data entry errors.

In essence, this is a practical guide for HR administrators who need to correct employee start dates and need to understand the full ripple effects of such corrections across the HR system.
ss: Correcting an employee's contract start date in CoreHR People Management requires understanding which contract elements automatically update and how payroll is affected. This guide walks you through amending start dates for new hires, rehires, and additional contracts, and identifies what gets updated across salary, allowances, pension, BIK, deductions, cost allocations, org roles, and other employee record fields. sl: This user guide from Access Group's People Management system provides comprehensive guidance on amending employee contract start dates within CoreHR, covering the processes for changing start dates and understanding the cascading effects throughout an employee's record. The document explains how to access the amendment functionality by opening an employee record in People Management, navigating to Contracts, and selecting the "Amend Contract Start Date" button, which launches a prompt where users enter the new start date. t: Contracts Key Concepts
s:
# Contracts Key Concepts Guide Summary

This guide introduces HR administrators to the fundamental concepts and terminology used in the PeopleXD People Management system when managing employee contracts.

**Key topics covered:**

- **Posts and Contracts relationship**: Explains that contracts are based on "posts" (also called post appointments) that are pre-configured in CoreHR. Posts serve as templates containing standard details like job title, location, and pay scale. When creating a new contract for any employee activity (new hire, replacement, additional contract, or rehire), administrators select an existing post, which the contract inherits. However, administrators can then customize individual contract details such as start date and working hours.

- **Accessing Posts**: Describes how the list of available posts displayed to users varies depending on two factors: the user's HR access permissions (which are linked to the organizational hierarchy) and the type of post configured in CoreHR. Access can be granted organization-wide or restricted to specific divisions or departments depending on the HR team structure.

- **Post Types**: Clarifies that posts are configured as either auto-authorised, auto-commenced, or non-auto. Auto posts are always searchable based on user permissions, while non-auto posts only appear if a post appointment has already been planned and authorised.

- **Contract FTE (Full-Time Equivalent)**: Notes that FTE values on contracts indicate whether an employee works full-time or part-time and can be entered manually by administrators or calculated automatically by CoreHR.
ss: Contract management in People Management relies on posts set up in CoreHR, which serve as templates that employees' contracts inherit from—including job title, location, pay scale, and other key details. HR administrators use this guide to understand how posts and contracts connect, how user access to posts is controlled through organizational hierarchy, and how contract full-time equivalent (FTE) is calculated based on standard hours and contracted hours. Open this document when you're setting up new hires, replacement contracts, additional contracts, or rehires, or when you need clarity on why certain posts appear or don't appear in your dropdown lists. This guide complements the HR Key Concepts and Managing Post Profiles documentation for complete contract setup knowledge.
sl: This user guide from Access Limited Distribution explains the foundational concepts and terminology required for managing employee contracts within the People Management system integrated with CoreHR. The document clarifies that contracts, also called Post Appointments, are created directly from pre-configured posts set up in CoreHR, which serve as blueprints containing essential details such as job title, organizational location, pay scale, and sanctioned headcount. When performing any new contract activity on People Management—including new hire, replacement contract, additional contract, or rehire—the HR administrator must first select an appropriate post from CoreHR and then has the ability to update contract-specific details such as start date and contract hours. The document addresses how post visibility is controlled through two key factors: the user's HR Access permissions, which are linked to the Organizational Hierarchy and can be restricted to specific divisions or opened organization-wide, and the Post Type configuration (Auto-Authorised, Auto-Commenced, or Non-Auto), where non-auto posts only appear if a Post Appointment has been formally Planned and Authorised. Additionally, the guide explains how Contract FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) is calculated by dividing the employee's contracted hours per week by the standard hours per week, with examples showing that a full-time employee working 37.5 hours weekly equals 1.0 FTE while a part-time employee working 18.75 hours equals 0.5 FTE, though FTE cannot exceed 1.0 on any single contract. This document is essential for HR administrators and People Management system users who need to understand how to properly set up, configure, and manage employee contracts in relation to organizational posts and FTE calculations.

t: Devolved People Management
s:
# Summary of "Devolved People Management" Guide

This guide explains how to set up and use **devolved HR functions** in the PeopleXD system — allowing managers to handle certain people management tasks directly from their Manager Dashboard, rather than requiring HR department involvement.

## What users will learn:

**How managers can perform HR tasks:**
- Add new employees and onboard successful applicants
- Process employee transfers
- Create and manage employment contracts
- Amend contract terms (e.g., change of hours)
- View team information via the HR Dashboard and "New Starters" widget
- Track approvals that roll up to their manager

**How to set up manager access:**
- Configure which HR functions individual managers can access
- Set default post access (the organisational structure/positions a manager can manage)
- Override default access on a case-by-case basis
- Configure the "Default Post Details" parameter to control which employees appear in a manager's team view
- Customise menu options for different manager roles

## Key concept:

This is an **optional, customisable feature** that organisations can enable to distribute HR responsibilities to managers. Rather than centralising all HR tasks in a dedicated department, managers gain controlled access to perform specific people management activities for their own teams through the Manager Dashboard.
ss: Managers can use the People XD Manager Dashboard to complete devolved HR functions including onboarding new starters, creating new contracts, processing transfers, amending contracts, and managing leavers—all without needing direct access to the full People Management dashboard. This guide explains how managers access these features through the 'My Team' widget, what HR tasks they can perform, and how administrators should configure user security profiles to control which functions each manager can use. Open this document when you need to understand what People Management capabilities your managers have, how they access them, or how to set up and customize manager access for your organization.
sl: This document is a user guide for the Devolved People Management feature in People XD, which allows managers to access and complete selected HR functions directly through the Manager Dashboard's "My Team" widget without requiring access to the full People Management dashboard. The guide explains that organizations can optionally devolve HR tasks such as onboarding new starters, creating new contracts, processing contract amendments, managing leavers, and updating employee records to their managers, with access controlled through user security profiles and custom configuration per implementation. Managers can access People Management functions in two ways via the My Team widget: through an Actions button for tasks like adding new employees or successful applicants, and through an Employee button for other functions. The document covers specific processes including Add New Employee / Successful Applicants, Transfers, the HR Dashboard, New Contract creation, and Change of Hours, alongside configuration of manager access through settings such as Default Manager Post Access, Override Manager Post Access, and the 'Default Post Details' parameter which determines default values for new starters based on organizational fields. System configuration sections detail menu options, post access controls, and parameter settings required to enable these devolved functions for different manager roles. The guide is designed for HR administrators and implementation teams who need to understand both how managers will use these features and how to configure system security and menu settings to control which functions are available to specific managers, with the important constraint that managers can only complete activities for employees within their own team.

t: Diversity Configuration
s:
# Diversity Configuration Guide Summary

This guide teaches users how to configure diversity-related fields in the PeopleXD HR system, specifically which information is displayed and how it can be accessed or edited.

## Key Learning Outcomes

After reading this guide, users will understand:

**What Diversity Config Does:**
- It controls which diversity-related fields appear on the "Background" and "Disability" screens within the Personnel Information section of the system
- It allows administrators to determine whether each field should be visible, hidden, read-only, or editable

**Where Configuration Applies:**
- The configuration settings are global and affect all users viewing employee diversity information through:
  - Employee Dashboard (employees viewing their own profile)
  - Manager Dashboard (managers viewing their team members' profiles)
- Note: These settings do NOT restrict HR administrators or devolved managers with HR responsibilities—they retain full access to all fields regardless of configuration

**Specific Sections That Can Be Configured:**
- Personal Details
- Diversity information
- Family Details
- Notes
- Disability Details (including general details and detailed notes sections)

**How to Access the Configuration:**
- The guide explains where to find the Diversity Config option on the HR Admin Setup Settings tab in the People Management dashboard

**Field Display Options:**
- Fields can be set to "View Only" (visible but not editable) or "Hide" (not displayed at all)

Essentially, this guide enables HR administrators to customize what diversity information is visible and editable for different user types in the system.
ss: Diversity Config lets you control which employee diversity and background information fields appear in CorePortal's Employee Profile screens—including gender, ethnic origin, nationality, disability details, and family information. You can configure each field to be hidden, view-only, or editable, and these settings apply globally to all employees and managers accessing profiles through the Employee or Manager dashboards. Open this guide when you need to set up which diversity data fields your organization wants to display, restrict, or allow edits on in CorePortal. HR administrators can access Diversity Config via People Management > Data Centre tab > HR Admin Setup Settings.
sl: This user guide provides comprehensive instructions for configuring the Diversity Config feature within the People Management system's HR Admin Setup Settings, which controls how diversity-related information is displayed and edited across employee profiles. The document explains how to access the Diversity Config screen by navigating to the Data Centre tab, selecting HR Admin Setup Settings, and clicking the Diversity Config option to open the configuration pop-up. The guide covers three main configuration sections—Personal Details, Diversity, and Family Details—each containing individual fields such as Gender, Gender Identity, Sexual Orientation, Date of Birth, NI Number, Previous Surname, Ethnic Origin, Nationality, and National Identity fields that can be independently configured. For each field and section, administrators can select one of three options: View Only (field displays but cannot be edited), Hide (field does not display), or Update (field displays and is editable), with the enabled option highlighted in blue on screen. These global configuration settings apply to all CorePortal users accessing diversity screens through the Employee Dashboard, Manager Dashboard, or People Management Dashboard, though HR administrators retain full access to all fields regardless of configuration settings. The document is designed for HR administrators and managers who need to control which diversity and disability information is visible or editable to end users based on organizational policies and privacy requirements.

t: DocuSign Integration
s:
# DocuSign Integration Guide Summary

This user guide covers how to integrate DocuSign electronic signature functionality with the PeopleXD People Management HR system.

## What You'll Learn

**Core Functionality:**
- How to send documents (such as employment contracts) from PeopleXD to employees for review and electronic signing through DocuSign
- How employees receive and sign documents via DocuSign after being sent from the system

**Practical Setup and Usage:**
- How to access the document sending features within an HR Admin Employee Record
- How to send individual documents and document templates through PeopleXD
- How to configure templates for use with DocuSign
- Which PeopleXD data fields are available to use in DocuSign documents

**System Configuration:**
- How to set up the DocuSign integration in PeopleXD's Admin screen, including:
  - Account details configuration
  - Email default settings
  - Document parameter settings
  - Template management
  - Designated user account setup for sending envelopes
- How to access integration menu options and administrative controls

**Additional Features:**
- How to use Insight Reporting in relation to the DocuSign integration
- Where to find additional DocuSign resources

**Key Integration Detail:**
The guide explains that HR users don't need individual DocuSign accounts—all documents are sent from a single shared organization account, with users accessing DocuSign in a restricted mode through PeopleXD to initiate and send document envelopes.
ss: PeopleXD People Management integrates with DocuSign to allow HR users to send documents—such as contracts of employment—directly to employees for electronic signature. HR admins can either send standalone documents from their local drive or use pre-configured templates that automatically pull employee data (name, job role, salary, hours) from PeopleXD employee records. Open this guide if you need to set up DocuSign integration, configure templates, send documents for signature, or track the signing status of envelopes within PeopleXD.
sl: This DocuSign Integration User Guide provides comprehensive instructions for HR administrators using PeopleXD People Management to send documents for employee signature via DocuSign eSignatures, such as Contracts of Employment. The integration allows HR users to initiate the DocuSign process directly from an employee's record in PeopleXD HR Admin through two methods: sending an already-completed document from a local or network drive, or sending a pre-configured template where PeopleXD employee data (name, job role, salary, hours) is automatically merged into the document fields. Users access DocuSign functionality through menu options in HR Admin that display "Send Document" and "Send Template" buttons in the left-hand navigation, with the employee's email address from their PeopleXD employee record (Contact Type EMAIL) automatically passed to DocuSign for delivery. All DocuSign envelopes are sent from a single shared organizational account rather than individual user accounts, with HR users accessing DocuSign in a restricted preview and send mode. The guide covers essential configuration steps including template setup where the Role field must be set as "XD Recipient" and the "Needs to Sign" action must be specified, as well as PeopleXD Admin Screen settings for Account Details, Email Defaults, Document Parameters, and Templates. Once an employee receives and completes the signing process in DocuSign, the envelope status (sent, completed) is viewable within PeopleXD, and the completed signed document is automatically saved against the employee's record.

t: Employee & Manager Requests
s:
# PeopleXD HR System: Employee & Manager Requests Guide Summary

This guide teaches users how to work with the Employee and Manager Requests feature in the PeopleXD People Management system. After reading it, users will understand:

## What Requests Are
The guide explains the distinction between Employee Requests (submitted by employees) and Manager Requests (submitted by managers), and how these function within the HR system.

## Setting Up Request Forms
Users will learn how to configure and manage request forms, including:
- Creating new request forms from scratch
- Adding custom fields to forms to capture specific information
- Adjusting form settings to suit organizational needs
- Previewing forms before deployment
- Editing, duplicating, or deleting existing forms

## Controlling Access to Forms
The guide covers how to restrict who can access particular request forms using criteria groups, ensuring only appropriate employees or managers can submit specific types of requests.

## Workflow and Automation
Users will understand how requests flow through the system, including how workflows are triggered and how the system can integrate with an EMS (likely an Employee Management System) to automate processes.

## Managing Active Requests
The guide explains how to submit requests, track their status, receive and respond to notifications about pending approvals, and view the history of requests. It also covers an administrative view for HR staff to oversee all requests in the system.

## Additional Configuration
The guide touches on extra setup options, including managing manager access to employee information and using insight views for reporting.
ss: Employee and Manager Requests in PeopleXD allows you to create and manage customizable request forms that employees and managers can submit through the system—such as requests for cycle to work schemes, equipment, contract changes, or leaver notifications. This guide covers how to set up request forms with custom fields, configure approval workflows, control access restrictions, and process incoming requests through the notification system. Open this document if you need to create new request forms, define who can access them, establish approval routing, or manage the status and history of submitted requests.
sl: This document is a comprehensive user guide for the Employee and Manager Requests functionality within PeopleXD People Management, covering both configuration and operational procedures. The guide explains that Employee Requests allow employees to submit request forms for items such as cycle to work schemes, childcare vouchers, or equipment, while Manager Requests enable managers to submit forms on behalf of employees for contract changes, leaver notifications, or access changes, with both types routed through workflow processes. The configuration section details how to access the Employee and Manager Requests screen from the People Management Dashboard via Data Centre > HR Admin Setup Settings, then create and manage request forms by adding fields, amending form settings, previewing forms, editing, cloning, or deleting existing forms. The guide covers access control mechanisms including assigning Criteria Groups to restrict form access, and describes the workflow process and EMS Trigger configuration for both employee and manager request types. The management section explains how to create requests, action request approvals through the Notification Centre, track request status and history, and access an admin view of all requests, while also covering additional configuration such as Manager Employee Access, Insight View, and user access settings including widgets and configuration screens. This document serves HR administrators, managers, and employees in the Access Group ecosystem who need to set up, submit, approve, or monitor various types of HR requests within the PeopleXD system.

t: Employee Bulk Updates
s:
# Employee Bulk Updates Guide — Summary

This guide teaches users how to use the **employee bulk update feature** in PeopleXD HR system to make large-scale changes to employee records efficiently, rather than updating records one at a time or requesting support from Optimisation Services.

## What you'll learn:

**Available Templates:**
- **Bulk End Allowances** — allows you to end multiple active allowances at once by providing personnel numbers, appointment IDs, allowance pay codes, and end dates. (Note: coordination with the Payroll team is recommended as changes automatically feed into PeopleXD Payroll)
- **Bulk Load Salary** — allows you to upload new salary amendments in bulk
- **Contract Templates** — the ability to create custom templates tailored to specific contract elements

**How to Use the Feature:**
- How to download templates and helper files from the Bulk Update Templates widget on the People Management dashboard
- How to prepare bulk update files for processing
- How to load files into the system, including using advanced settings
- How to identify and correct errors in bulk updates
- How to process records once validated
- How to manage uploaded files

**System Configuration:**
- How to configure menu options and dashboard settings to support bulk update operations

The guide is designed to enable HR users to perform large-scale employee record updates independently without needing specialist support.
ss: Employee Bulk Updates in PeopleXD People Management allows you to update multiple employee records at scale using templates, including ending allowances, loading salary amendments, and amending contracts. This feature eliminates the need for time-consuming individual updates by letting you download standard templates or create custom ones tailored to your specific contract fields. Open this guide when you need to bulk update employee data, prepare CSV files for upload, or understand how to load and process multiple records through the system. You'll also find configuration steps and advanced settings for managing approvals during the bulk update process.
sl: This document is a user guide for the Employee Bulk Updates feature within PeopleXD People Management, designed to help users update employee records at scale without requiring individual manual updates or assistance from Optimisation Services. The guide covers the Bulk Update Templates widget accessible from the People Management dashboard, which provides two default templates: Bulk End Allowances (requiring personnel number, appointment ID, allowance pay code, and end date) and Bulk Load Salary (requiring personnel number, appointment ID, updated salary, and effective date). Users can also create custom contract templates by navigating to the Bulk Update Templates widget, expanding the Actions menu, selecting Create Contract Template, searching for required fields, moving them to the Selected column, and saving the template with a name. The document explains the file preparation process, including downloading templates and helper files from the three-dot menu and ensuring files are saved in .CSV format with pipe-delimited records. Processing bulk updates occurs through the Employee Bulk Updates widget on the People Management dashboard, with options to load files, configure advanced settings such as bypassing or enabling salary approval processes, and manage file uploads. The guide notes important considerations such as coordinating with the Payroll team before processing allowance or contract updates, as changes automatically feed into PeopleXD Payroll, and confirms that only commenced or confirmed future contracts can be amended, excluding fields specified on the Organisation Structure.

t: Employee Files
s:
# Summary of the Employee Files User Guide

This guide teaches HR administrators how to manage the Files section within the PeopleXD HR system, which is used to store and organize documents related to employee records and their associated contracts.

**Key topics covered include:**

**Understanding the Files Feature:**
- How documents get linked to employee records (uploaded directly by HR administrators, generated automatically by the system, or uploaded by employees and managers)
- Who has access to view files (administrators, employees, and managers) and how these permissions can be configured
- What document types are and their role in the system
- Security and administrator access options for files

**Managing Files Practically:**
- How to access the Files screen in the system
- How to view existing files
- How to add files to employee records, including separate procedures for adding employee files and contract files
- How to add multiple files at once
- How to delete files
- Understanding files that are automatically generated by PeopleXD
- How employees can access and interact with their own files
- How managers can access employee files (both through a dedicated Files option and through the employee profile)

The guide is designed as a step-by-step reference for HR administrators who need to upload documents, manage access permissions, and maintain employee file records within the system.
ss: The Employee Files feature in People Management allows HR administrators to upload, organize, and manage documents associated with employee records and contracts through document categorization types. You can upload files directly, view files uploaded by employees or managers, and control access permissions for administrators, employees, and managers based on document type or unrestricted access. Open this guide when you need to add employee or contract files to records, delete files, configure who can view specific documents, or understand how automatically generated documents are stored in the system. This is essential for HR teams managing personnel documentation and controlling document visibility across different user roles.
sl: This user guide provides comprehensive guidance on managing employee documentation within the People Management system's Files section, which is primarily used by HR administrators to upload, organize, and control access to employee-related documents. The document explains how files are linked to employee records through multiple pathways: direct upload by HR administrators via the People Management > Files screen, automatic generation through the Document and Email Generation feature in CoreHR, uploads by employees via their My Profile > Documents screen, or uploads by managers through the Employee Profile > Documents screen or Files screen if manager access has been devolved. Files are organized using Document Types, which categorize documents as either Person-type (related directly to the employee) or Contract-type (related to specific employee contracts), allowing for granular access control where viewing and upload permissions can be defined per Document Type for administrators, employees, and managers. The guide covers key operational tasks including how to access the Files screen from the Command Centre > Employees section and select the Files option in the employee's HR record, along with procedures for viewing, adding individual employee files, adding contract files, adding multiple files simultaneously, and deleting files. Security configuration is addressed through two access models for administrators: unrestricted access to all files and Document Types, or restricted access configured on a per-Document Type basis. The Files screen displays all stored documentation with details including file name, Document Type category, upload date, and uploader information, with contract-specific files displaying based on the selected contract while employee-level files always remain visible regardless of contract selection.

t: Employee Files Configuration
s:
# Employee Files Configuration Guide Summary

This guide teaches users how to set up and manage the Files feature in the PeopleXD HR system, specifically focusing on two main areas:

## Document Type Configuration
Users will learn how to create, edit, and manage document types — the categories used to classify and organize employee files. This includes:
- Accessing the Document Type management screen through the Template Configuration Centre
- Adding new document types by entering a code (up to 13 alphanumeric characters) and description
- Setting whether a document type is active (visible in dropdown menus throughout the system) or disabled (hidden from view)
- Configuring additional options for each document type, such as:
  - Whether documents are associated at the person level (tied to an employee) or contract level (tied to a specific employment contract)
  - Whether employees can view documents of that type through their own Employee Profile screen
- Editing and deleting existing document types

## Access Control and Permissions
Users will understand how to manage who can access employee files and documents across different user roles:
- **Administrators** — can have full access to all files or restricted access by specific document types
- **Employees** — can view certain documents assigned to them via the Employee Profile screen (if enabled for that document type)
- **Managers** — can access employee files through either the Files section or the Employee Profile option

In essence, this guide enables HR administrators to configure a secure, organized document management system within PeopleXD that controls what types of documents exist in the system and who can view them.
ss: Employee Files Configuration on PeopleXD covers how to set up and manage the Files feature, including creating document types and controlling who can access employee files. The guide walks you through configuring document types in the Template Configuration Centre, setting whether files are linked to a person or contract level, and enabling visibility for employees and managers through Employee Self Service (ESS) and Manager Self Service (MSS) options. You'll open this document when you need to define new document categories for employee records, adjust file permissions for different user roles (administrators, employees, or managers), or troubleshoot why certain file types aren't appearing in upload dropdowns. This is essential reading for HR administrators responsible for setting up PeopleXD's document management system.
sl: This user guide provides comprehensive instructions for configuring the Files feature within PeopleXD's People Management system, specifically covering Document Type setup and access management across different user roles. The document explains how to manage Document Types through the Template Configuration Centre by navigating to Data Centre > Reference Data and searching for "Document Type," where administrators can add new types by clicking Add and entering a code (up to 13 alphanumeric characters), description, and active status. Document Type configuration includes setting indicators for whether documents associate at person or contract level, and enabling ESS (Employee Self-Service) or MSS (Manager Self-Service) options to control visibility and upload permissions on the Employee Profile and Upload Document screens. The guide addresses access management for three user categories: Administrators can have either full access to all files through the "File Administrator" menu option or restricted access by Document Type using the "File View" option combined with "File Upload" permissions; Employees can view and upload documents through the Employee Profile screen if ESS options are enabled; and Managers can access and manage their team members' files through either the Files option or Employee Profile option depending on MSS configuration. The document resolves scenarios where organizations need to restrict file visibility and upload capabilities based on document classification, user role, and organizational hierarchy. This guide is primarily used by HR administrators and system configuration specialists who need to establish controlled access to employee documents within the PeopleXD system.

t: Employee Record Configuration
s:

The guide provides step-by-step instructions for each dashboard option within the employee record, enabling HR administrators and authorized users to configure, view, and maintain comprehensive employee information within the PeopleXD system.
ss: Employee Record Configuration covers how to set up and manage employee data in the HR system, including key information, contracts, salary, pension, deductions, cost allocations, and probation details. Use this guide when you need to view, update, or configure employee records, manage manager assignments, adjust work schedules, or organize dashboard display options. Open this document if you're an HR administrator or payroll user who needs step-by-step instructions for accessing and modifying employee profile information and related HR data fields.
sl: This user guide provides comprehensive documentation for configuring and managing employee records within the Access Limited Distribution HR system, specifically covering the People Management module. The document explains how to access the HR Employee Record and navigate the dashboard, including the Contract List and Actions Button Items in the Dashboard Header. It details multiple dashboard options and their associated tasks, such as viewing and updating Key Information, managing Contracts with summary options and update procedures, changing Manager assignments, viewing Current Salary and Pension Contributions, managing Deductions and Cost Allocations, and uploading Files. Additional sections cover configuration of Probation Details, Balances, Work Schedules, Talent Pool assignments, Application Details, and Demobilisation Dates, with specific instructions on viewing, updating, and editing each element. The guide also addresses Employee Dashboard Setup customization, including how to reorder dashboard items through the menu options, and explains access controls such as hiding a user's own HR record and managing access to Personal Information including Next of Kin details. This document is designed for HR administrators and payroll users who need to configure employee records, manage employment contracts, and maintain accurate personnel data within the system.

t: Employee Transfers
s:

- How to access the transfer requests feature in the system
- How to create a new transfer request by searching for an employee and the target position
- How to complete and submit a transfer request

**Tracking Transfer Status:**
- How to view submitted transfer requests and their current status

**System Access Control:**
- How HR administrator access is restricted based on organisational units (company, department, division), which determines which employee records and transfers they can view and manage

The guide provides step-by-step instructions for both HR administrators initiating transfers and approvers handling transfer decisions within the system.
ss: Employee Transfers in CoreHR allows HR administrators to request the movement of employees between departments or contracts when they lack direct access to the employee's current record. Use this guide when you need to transfer an employee to a new position in a different organizational unit that you have access to, but the employee's current contract is managed by another HR administrator. The document covers the complete transfer workflow: creating transfer requests, tracking their status, approving or rejecting requests, and finalizing the new contract once approved. You'll open this if you manage employees across multiple departments or need to coordinate transfers with other HR teams who control different parts of your organization.
sl: This user guide covers the Transfers feature within the XD People Management system, providing comprehensive instructions for HR administrators on creating, managing, and approving employee transfer requests. The document explains the core concept of transfers, which arise when an HR administrator needs to move an employee to a new contract or post but lacks access to the employee's current organizational unit in CoreHR due to HR Access restrictions based on designated company, department, or division levels. It describes how to view submitted requests and their associated current and proposed contracts, monitor transfer history, and cancel requests if needed. This resource is designed for HR administrators within Access Group's CoreHR system who need to facilitate employee movement across organizational boundaries where direct access restrictions would normally prevent them from using the standard Replace Contract process.

t: Employee's Salary Data Configuration

sl: This user guide provides comprehensive configuration instructions for the Current Salary screen within the People Management system, covering access requirements, available functions, and system settings that administrators need to implement. Beyond base salary management, the guide covers an Allowances Tab where users can view, add, edit, delete, and cancel employee allowances, as well as an Increment History Tab for viewing and editing increment records. The document also explains configuration parameters for salary amendments, including options to require reasons and comments, set default pay details, apply FTE multipliers, hide specific rate types (hourly, weekly, or daily), and restrict the amendment screen to display only approved salaries. This guide is primarily intended for People Management administrators and HR professionals who configure system access and manage employee salary data within the XD People Management platform.

t: Ending a Contract
s:
# Summary: Ending a Contract User Guide

This guide teaches HR administrators how to end a single contract for an employee who has multiple active contracts in the PeopleXD system.

**Key learning outcomes:**

After reading this guide, users will understand:

- **The scope**: This process applies only to ending one contract while keeping the employee's other active contracts intact. It does not cover making an employee a leaver from the organisation entirely (which is covered separately).

- **What gets ended together**: When you end a contract, all related contract elements are also automatically ended, including salary, allowances, deductions, pension scheme assignments, and cost allocation assignments.

- **The step-by-step process**: Users will learn how to navigate to an employee's record, access their contracts, and select the specific contract to end.

- **Required information**: Users must enter a Leaving Date (mandatory) and can optionally add a Leaving Code, Leaving Destination, Location After Leaving, and comments.

- **Additional features available**: The guide shows how to access Notice Periods functionality (for recording resignation or employer notification dates), the Leaving Summary screen (which displays all contract elements being affected), and Appointment Details (a read-only view of organisational structure and contract information).

- **The outcome**: The contract will be marked as "Ended" status and remain visible to HR administrators for review, but will no longer be active.
ss: Ending a Contract covers how to terminate a single employment contract for an employee with multiple active contracts in the People Management system, while keeping their other contracts unaffected. Use this guide when you need to end one specific contract and want to understand what associated elements—like salary, allowances, deductions, and pension assignments—will also be ended as part of that process. The guide walks through the Command Centre interface, required fields like leaving date and leaving code, and shows you how to review a summary of all impacted contract elements before saving. Open this document if you're managing contract terminations and need step-by-step instructions, or if you need to understand how the system automatically designates a new substantive contract after one is ended.
sl: This user guide provides instructions for ending a single contract for an employee who holds multiple active contracts within the People Management system, distinct from the process of making an employee a leaver from the organization. The process begins by navigating to Command Centre > Employees, searching for the employee, selecting the Contracts tab, and choosing the specific contract to end before clicking the End Contract button. The End Contract screen requires users to populate the mandatory Leaving Date field (the final date of employment and last payment date) along with optional fields including Leaving Code, Leaving Destination, Location After Leaving, and Comments (up to 80 characters), while ensuring the End All Contracts toggle remains disabled when ending only a single contract. Users can access additional functionality through the Actions menu to record Notice Periods for Employee Resignation or Employer Notification dates, view a Leaving Summary that displays associated contract elements being ended such as Cost Allocations, Allowances, Deductions, Annual Leave Balance, and Pension Scheme Assignments, and review read-only Appointment Details showing the Org Structure and Contract information. After clicking Save, the contract transitions to "Ended" status and remains visible to HR administrators on the employee record with its date range displayed from start to end date. The document also explains the Substantive Date Impact functionality, which automatically designates a new contract as substantive after the previous substantive contract ends, selecting based on highest FTE, earliest start date, or earliest input date if needed, with the Substantive Date set to the day after the ended contract's end date.

t: GDPR
s:
# GDPR Guide Summary

This guide teaches users how to manage GDPR compliance tasks within the PeopleXD HR system. After reading it, users will understand and be able to:

**Core GDPR Features:**
- Navigate and use the GDPR Request Centre, which is the central hub for managing all GDPR-related activities

**Right to Be Forgotten Requests:**
- Understand what the "Right to Be Forgotten" means under GDPR
- Create and process deletion requests for both employees and candidates
- Know what specific data gets deleted when these requests are processed
- Manage access permissions for these deletion requests

**Subject Access Requests:**
- Understand what a Subject Access Request is (a data subject's right to access their personal data)
- Create and submit new Subject Access Requests
- Download the requested data in different formats (CSV and JSON files)
- Access and review other related documents
- Generate insight reports to track Subject Access Requests

**Reporting and Monitoring:**
- Use the reporting features within the Insight tool to track and analyze GDPR activity
- View GDPR data organized by different perspectives: activity, categories, and request details
- Classify report sensitivity levels for data protection purposes

**Data Privacy:**
- Review and manage data privacy statements within the system

The guide provides step-by-step instructions for carrying out these compliance tasks to help organizations meet their GDPR obligations.
ss: PeopleXD's GDPR features help you manage data subject requests and maintain compliance with data protection regulations. The GDPR Request Centre lets you submit, track, and process Subject Access Requests and Right to Be Forgotten requests for both employees and candidates, including downloading exported data files. Use Insight reporting to monitor GDPR activity and apply sensitivity classifications to reports. Open this guide when you need to handle data requests, delete candidate or employee records upon request, or generate GDPR compliance reports.
sl: This user guide for PeopleXD version 27+ provides comprehensive guidance on implementing and managing GDPR compliance features within the system, covering the management of GDPR requests, reporting capabilities, and data privacy compliance. The document details the GDPR Request Centre screen, which enables users to search for existing requests, submit new Subject Access Requests and Right to be Forgotten requests, track their progress, and view or download associated reports and documentation. It explains the Right to be Forgotten process for both employees and candidates, including how to create delete requests and what data is removed when these requests are processed, with specific guidance on accessing these requests and managing candidate information in the PeopleXD Recruitment module. The guide covers Subject Access Request functionality, including how to create and submit requests, download output files in CSV or JSON formats, and access related Insight reports. For reporting purposes, the document describes how to use the Insight reporting tool to generate reports through the GDPR Business Area with Activity View, Category View, and Request Data View options, allowing organisations to track submitted requests and system tables included in Subject Access and Right to be Forgotten requests. Additionally, it explains the Report Sensitivity Classification feature that applies data classification labels to Insight reports across all export formats, and describes the Data Privacy Statement functionality displayed on portal login. This guide is designed for PeopleXD users responsible for managing GDPR compliance and data subject requests within their organisations.

t: GDPR Configuration
s:
# GDPR Configuration Guide Summary

This guide teaches administrators how to set up and configure GDPR compliance features in the PeopleXD HR system (version 27 and above). After reading it, users will be able to:

**User Access Management:**
- Grant appropriate user access to GDPR features through the GDPR Menu Profile
- Control who can access the Request Centre where GDPR requests are handled
- Manage access to the GDPR Business Area in the Insight reporting tool
- Set up role-based access controls for employee records, including identifying the correct organizational roles, defining organizational groups, and assigning roles to employees

**System Configuration:**
- Configure GDPR control parameters, specifically setting statutory retention periods for data deletion and cleardown timelines for processing requests
- Customize the Data Privacy Statement that appears to users, including configurable elements like title messages, body text (multiple message sections), and links
- Publish the privacy statement and manage version control when updates are needed
- Handle multi-language considerations when using language packs and apply formatting using Markdown

**Security:**
- Restrict access to GDPR features by IP address to enhance security

The guide focuses on the administrative setup and configuration steps needed to enable GDPR functionality, rather than explaining how end users interact with the system once it's configured.
ss: PeopleXD's GDPR Configuration guide covers setup and administration of GDPR compliance features in the system, including enabling the GDPR Requests centre, configuring user access controls, and publishing data privacy statements. It helps organizations establish proper security controls by defining menu profiles, assigning organizational roles, and restricting access to employee records based on job function and organizational hierarchy. Open this document when you need to set up GDPR functionality for the first time, grant staff permission to handle data subject requests, or configure privacy notices and access parameters in PeopleXD.
sl: This document is a configuration guide for the PeopleXD system (SAAS v27+) that provides step-by-step instructions for setting up GDPR functionality within an organization's HR platform. The guide covers five main configuration areas: enabling the GDPR Requests centre, managing user access through menu profiles and organizational roles, configuring GDPR control parameters such as statutory deletion years and cleardown days, creating and publishing customizable Data Privacy Statements, and restricting access to GDPR features by IP address. For user access management, administrators must create a new Menu Profile in the Security section, then enable specific system menu options—specifically "CorePortal GDPR Requests" for access to the Request Centre on the People Management Data Centre widget, and "Coreportal - Analytics Area GDPR" for access to the Core GDPR business area in Insight. Access to employee records is controlled through assigning users an organizational role (GDPR Org Role) aligned to specific organization groups, a three-step process involving identifying the appropriate org role, defining the org group for alignment, and assigning the role to employees. The Data Privacy Statement section explains how to configure customizable content including title messages, up to five additional message fields, two configurable links, and publishing controls, with support for multiple languages through Language Packs and Markdown formatting. This guide is designed for system administrators and GDPR coordinators who need to configure the platform before end users can access GDPR features, with the actual operational procedures for using those features covered in a separate GDPR User Guide.

t: HR Admin Field options
s:
# Summary: HR Admin Field Options Guide

This guide teaches HR administrators how to configure and manage field display settings in the PeopleXD People Management system.

After reading this guide, users will understand and be able to:

**Display Options Configuration:**
- Control which fields appear on key HR screens including the New Hire wizard, Replace Contract wizard, Additional Contract wizard, Rehire wizard, End Person/End Contract screens, Key Information, and Contracts pages
- Set fields as either mandatory or optional (mandatory fields display with a red asterisk)
- Hide or show specific fields based on organizational requirements
- Configure display settings for employee records, contract records, salary information, leaver information, personnel numbers, key information, and continuous service data

**Combo Field Options Configuration:**
- Manage drop-down list options on CoreHR that are linked to Reference Data items
- Customize which options appear in contract-specific combo fields

**Key Practical Skills:**
- Access the HR Admin Field Options screen
- Update and change field display settings
- Understand which field options are available for different record types
- Perform any additional configuration needed to implement these settings

The guide provides detailed breakdowns of all available display options across different wizards and screens, as well as information about combo field configuration and any related system configuration requirements.
ss: HR Admin Field Options in People Management lets you control which fields appear and how they behave on CoreHR screens like the New Hire wizard, Replace Contract wizard, Key Information, and other HR Admin functions. You can configure whether specific fields are mandatory, hidden, or optional, and choose whether dropdown lists display just descriptions or codes with descriptions. Open this guide when you need to customize field visibility and requirements across your employee and contract record management processes. Use it to understand how to access the HR Admin Field Options configuration screen and update settings that apply globally across all system users.
sl: This user guide provides comprehensive guidance on the HR Admin Field Options functionality within the People Management system, which allows administrators to control the display and configuration of key fields on employee and contract records in CoreHR. The document covers two main feature types: Display Options, which control whether fields appear on screens and whether they are mandatory or optional, and Combo Field Options, which determine whether dropdown lists display only descriptions or both codes and descriptions. The Display Options functionality applies specifically to screens including the Create Person Wizard, Key Information, Continuous Service, and various contract-related wizards, and administrators access these settings by navigating to the Data Centre widget, opening HR Admin Setup Settings, and selecting HR Admin Field Options. For Display Options, administrators can configure fields with three statuses—Hide (field not displayed), Mandatory (field displayed with a red asterisk indicating required completion), or Blank (field displayed but optional)—by selecting the relevant screen, searching for the field, and clicking Edit to modify the settings. The guide explains that changes made to Display Options are applied immediately and globally across the entire system, affecting all users, though certain fields required for all employee and contract records cannot be modified. The Combo Field Options feature specifically controls how contract-related dropdown lists appear by allowing selection between displaying the Description only or displaying both Code and Description together. Additionally, the document notes that these field options apply exclusively to the specified HR Admin screens and do not affect fields with similar labels appearing elsewhere in CoreHR such as the Employee Profile or People Management dashboard.

t: HR Changes
s:
# Summary of "HR Changes" User Guide

This guide teaches PeopleXD Talent system users how to manage and process HR changes through the HR Changes tab. Specifically, users will learn:

## Main Functionality
- How to review two types of HR events: **Leaver changes** (employees leaving the organisation) and **New HR Manager changes** (employees gaining a new manager due to role changes or restructuring)
- How to **approve or reject these changes** to ensure that related appraisals and objectives are properly updated

## Leaver Management
The guide explains how the system identifies and handles employees leaving:
- Leavers are flagged when they have an end date in the past and active appraisal or objective cycles
- Users learn the **eligibility criteria** for which appraisals and objectives are affected:
  - **Appraisals** are eligible if the end date falls within the appraisal cycle dates, or if the appraisal is incomplete after the cycle end date
  - **Objective cycles** are eligible if the end date falls within the objective cycle dates
  - Special rules apply for employees with historical end dates or end dates on the last day of the month
- Users understand what happens when a leaver change is approved: affected talent items are cancelled, previous managers lose visibility of the employee, and appraisals are updated accordingly

## New HR Manager Changes
The guide covers how to manage situations where employees receive new managers.

## Practical Operation
The guide provides instructions on how to **access the HR Changes screen** and **action changes for both individual employees and multiple employees at once**.
ss: The HR Changes tab in PeopleXD Talent lets you review and approve leaver and manager changes that impact employee appraisals and objectives. When an employee leaves the organization or moves to a new manager, eligible appraisals and objectives are flagged in this screen so you can approve or reject updates that cascade to talent records, dashboards, and admin views. Open this guide when you need to process leaver changes (which cancel affected talent items) or manager reassignments (which update the manager assigned to in-progress appraisals and objectives). The changes sync nightly from People Management, and you can approve single or multiple employees at once.
sl: This user guide for PeopleXD Talent provides comprehensive guidance on using the HR Changes tab to review and action employee-related changes that impact appraisals and objectives within the system. The document covers two primary HR events: Leavers (employees with past end dates) and New HR Manager changes (employees who have moved roles or whose reporting structure has changed), explaining the eligibility criteria for each scenario based on appraisal and objective cycle dates. When accessing the HR Changes screen from the Talent Dashboard, users can search for employees by name or personnel number, filter by HR Event type, and select individual or multiple employees to process changes. The guide details specific system updates that occur when changes are approved: Leaver approvals result in Talent items being marked as Cancelled status, preventing them from appearing in active employee counts or standard Admin Options submenus like Manager Overview, though they remain viewable through the Manage Review or Manage Objectives tabs for potential reversal. New HR Manager approvals update associated Talent items with the new manager assignment while removing visibility from the previous manager's dashboard. The document is designed for system administrators who need to approve or reject these HR-driven changes to ensure appraisals, objectives, and dashboard views accurately reflect organizational structure updates synchronized nightly from People Management.

ss: HR administrators and line managers use the PeopleXD People Management dashboard to view and update comprehensive employee records, including contracts, salary, pension contributions, deductions, and workforce management data like absences and work schedules. The Employee Record screen centralizes all HR information in one location, with configurable tabs covering key employee details, payroll information, and compliance requirements such as probation status and notice periods. sl: This user guide documents the HR Employee Record feature within PeopleXD People Management, a system provided by Access Group for managing employee information and HR processes. The document provides comprehensive instructions for HR administrators and line managers on accessing and navigating the Employee Record screen, which is reached by going to the People Management Dashboard, selecting Command Centre, clicking View on Employees, searching for the employee, and clicking View. The Employee Record screen contains multiple configurable tabs organized into two main categories: Employee Record Tabs (including Key Information, Contracts, Manager, Current Salary with sub-tabs for Allowances and Increment History, Pension Contributions, Deductions, Cost Allocations, User Defined Data, Files, Probation Details, Contact Information, Notice Period, Docusign, Payroll Instructional Forms, Demobilisation Date, Application Details, Task List, and Talent Pool) and Workforce Management Tabs (including Balances, Change Work Schedule, Team Area Assignment, Absences, and Person Settings with sub-sections for Employee Settings, Working Time Directive, Bradford Factor, and Extra Hours Recording).
